cards.text: Paul the apostle is on his way to Jerusalem, and he just told the elders of the church in Ephesus they'd never see his face again, and they all wept (Acts 20:22, 25, 37-38). In town after town, the Holy Spirit has warned him that chains and afflictions are waiting (Acts 20:23). Now Paul and his travel crew tear themselves away and sail to Cos, then Rhodes, then Patara.

cards.question: At Patara, Paul's crew finds a ship crossing over to a new region. Where's it headed?

cards.text: They spot Cyprus, pass south of it and land at Tyre in Syria. And friend, that ship isn't stopping because Paul asked nicely.

cards.question: So why the stop? The ship is at Tyre to unload its ___.

cards.text: They look up the disciples in Tyre and stay SEVEN DAYS. That's not a layover, friend, that's moving in.

cards.question: Through the Spirit, the disciples in Tyre keep telling Paul something about going up to Jerusalem. What is it?

answers.text: Not to go up at all

cards.question: After all those warnings in Tyre, Paul calls off the trip and stays there.

cards.text: When the week's up, all the disciples walk them out of the city, wives and children too. Somebody check on Tyre, friend, because I think the whole church just left town.

cards.question: Down on the beach outside Tyre, what does everyone do before Paul's crew leaves?

answers.text: Read a letter from Ephesus together

cards.question: After the farewells on the beach, the disciples from Tyre head back home.

cards.text: The voyage from Tyre ends at Ptolemais, where Paul's crew greets the brothers and stays with them for a day.

Leaving the next day, they go on to Caesarea and stay at the home of Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven chosen to serve the church (Acts 6:2-5). Everywhere Paul lands, somebody takes him in, and I spent YEARS in a junk drawer without ONE invitation.
Philip has four unmarried daughters who prophesy. Several days in, a prophet named Agabus comes down from Judea.
Agabus walks over, takes a belt and ties up his own feet and hands with it. Most folks bring cookies when they visit, friend, but Agabus brings a DEMONSTRATION.

cards.question: Agabus says the Holy Spirit says the Jews of Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt in this same way. Whose belt is it?
Agabus says the Jews of Jerusalem will bind the belt's owner and hand him over to the ___.

cards.text: Paul's crew and the people of Caesarea hear it, and they ALL plead with Paul not to go up to Jerusalem. Me? I'd have wrapped my mustache around his ankle and held on.

cards.question: Paul asks the people pleading with him why they're weeping and breaking his heart.
Paul answers the people pleading with him. For the name of the Lord Jesus, what does he say he's ready for in Jerusalem?

answers.text: To be bound and even to die
To argue his case in court
To preach and then slip away

cards.question: Paul won't be talked out of going, and his friends keep on pleading with him.

cards.text: Instead, they quiet down and say, "The Lord's will be done." Then they pack up and go on to Jerusalem, warnings and all.

cards.question: Who goes along with Paul's crew on the way to Jerusalem?

cards.text: Those disciples take them to stay at the home of Mnason the Cypriot, an early disciple.
